items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 5:02 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Acknowledgement - Holocaust
notes: The Mayor acknowledged January 27, 2025, which is the International Holocaust Remembrance Day, stating this date is the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz-Birkenau.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting recessed at 5:05 p.m. and reconvened at 6:00 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present. Councillor A. Owodunni was participating virtually.

items.title: Labour Relations Matter (Labour Relations Matter - Section 239 (2) (d)), DSD-2024-497
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for January 27, 2025.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 6:01 p.m.
